G1.observation: After 60 s idle the freshness timer cleared Conflicts, Candidates, and Effects, and the search path restored only status and results, so the page showed badge `ready` with 'No unresolved conflicts' (fixture has 1), 'No reviewable candidates' (has 2), and no pending forget lifecycle until a manual Refresh.
G1.fix: ensureFreshStatus() now re-reads the whole surface via load() instead of status alone, so a search on an expired status repopulates every panel. Independently, a panel with no data renders an explicit not-loaded state (MemoryPanelUnloaded: 'Not loaded. Use Refresh memory to read this panel.', or 'Loading' while a reload is in flight) instead of its empty-state copy, so an unread panel can never read as 'none' by any path.
G1.red: e2e idle spec rewritten to assert fixture counts after idle-then-search; dashboard/src/memory-store-freshness.test.ts 'searches after the status freshness window by re-reading the whole surface'
G1.green: e2e 11/11; real browser at 1440/640/390 shows 1 conflict, 2 candidates, and 'Forgetting / Pending owner approval' restored after a 65 s idle then search

G1_regression_found_and_fixed.severity: blocker introduced by the G1 fix, caught before handoff
G1_regression_found_and_fixed.observation: load() tail-calls run(lastQuery), and run() called ensureFreshStatus(), which calls load(). A provider that answers with a status it already reports stale (MemoryStatus.state is an open string) drove unbounded re-entry: the RED test measured 9 status reads for one reload before a throw-guard stopped it.
G1_regression_found_and_fixed.fix: run(query, reload=false) inside a reload takes the status just read rather than re-entering; the surface then self-heals through the freshness timer.
G1_regression_found_and_fixed.red: dashboard/src/memory-store-freshness.test.ts 'reads the surface a bounded number of times when the provider itself reports a stale status': expected 1, received 9

N1.observation: With the provider offline the Conflicts panel still said 'No unresolved conflicts', against the candidate's own DESIGN.md line 'offline or unavailable is never presented as an empty result'.
N1.fix: MemoryConflicts renders offline, unavailable, and incompatible reads as danger-ramp copy keyed by memoryResourceState, and keeps the empty state only for a current read.
N1.green: layout spec asserts 0 occurrences of 'No unresolved conflicts' in the offline Conflicts region; 09-offline@390.png inspected

N6.observation: A provider-reported stale read left the badge at `ready`; only the Search panel notice mentioned staleness.
N6.fix: The badge now separates `expired` (our 60 s status token lapsed) from `stale` (the provider reported stale evidence); a provider stale read propagates to the badge with its own copy, and both sit on the warning ramp. Mutations stay off the ready path.
N6.green: layout spec asserts badge text 'stale' in the stale state; 09-stale@1440.png inspected

N3.observation: memory-record-history.ts derived `forgotten` from the 8 most recent suppressions, where the prior check was an unbounded EXISTS; with more than 8 later correction suppressions sharing an identity, a forgotten record would render as a 'Superseded record' row.
N3.fix: A dedicated bounded existence query (operation='forget' ... LIMIT 1) answers it exactly, independent of MEMORY_HISTORY_LIMIT.

N4.observation: Bidi control characters from the provider (U+202E) were rendered, so 'evil' displayed as 'live'.
N4.fix: The projection strips bidi embedding, override, and isolate controls (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) from excerpt and derived title.
N4.red: tests/unit/task32-memory-redaction.test.ts 'strips bidi override controls from provider text before projection'

announcement_lifetime.observation: The single atomic status region kept a staging announcement ('Pending owner approval') across the freshness expiry, hiding the 'Memory status expired' copy: the same family of defect as G1 (an outcome the surface had outlived presented as current).
announcement_lifetime.fix: An outcome is held with the search generation that produced it; expiry, a privacy-epoch change, or a new search retires it and the region reverts to provider copy. Recorded in DESIGN.md.
